niche_preference_profile: This user tends to prefer interfaces that feel curated, visually intentional, and clearly structured. They often respond well to strong hierarchy, concise direct messaging, integrated screen context, and either spacious editorial presentation or compact high-contrast density depending on task type. They repeatedly favor layouts with clearer grouping, stronger focal paths, and more decisive action emphasis over flatter, generic, or weakly structured screens.

criteria.description: Prefers screens with strong visual hierarchy, clear focal order, and well-separated sections rather than flat or weakly differentiated layouts.
Prefers actions and alerts embedded within a visible product screen with surrounding navigation and supporting context, rather than isolated modal-only presentations.
Prefers shorter, punchier, more specific copy and headlines that communicate status or action directly rather than softer, more conversational, or generic wording.
Prefers primary actions that are visually prominent, high-contrast, and clearly signaled, with stronger CTA emphasis and clearer next-step framing.
Prefers content organized into coherent grouped panels or modules with internal hierarchy and balanced action layouts, rather than fragmented repeated rows or one-track single-action framing.
